Type Passive

Resistance 5 (10 at 11th, 15 at 17th)

Your Rig's core gains resistance to possession, banishment, and effects targeting bound spirits.

cinderfall.incomplete: The scaling-Resistance-by-level shape itself is trivially real (Rubbery Skin precedent) -- but the target is explicitly "your Rig's core," and [RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS]/[RIG-NO-ACTOR] mean there is no single, consistent item/actor to attach a Resistance rule element to across all three Rig choices. Would be REAL if retargeted at the PC directly; it is not written that way.
